name: Art and Antiquities Trafficking
description: Looting, theft, forgery and illicit trade of cultural property, and use of art as a store of value to launder funds. Opaque transactions, free ports, falsified provenance and anonymous buyers are common features.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing in the Art and Antiquities Market (2023)
UNESCO, Convention on the Means of Prohibiting and Preventing the Illicit Import, Export and Transfer of Ownership of Cultural Property (1970)
UNIDROIT, Convention on Stolen or Illegally Exported Cultural Objects (1995)
INTERPOL, Stolen Works of Art Database

indicators.name: Provenance gaps or documents inconsistent with object history
indicators.canon: Provenance gaps or documents inconsistent with object history
indicators.desc: Missing ownership chain, 1970-era gap or fake certificates.
indicators.ctx: Missing ownership chain, 1970-era gap or fake certificates.

indicators.name: Price inconsistent with market or sudden value jumps
indicators.canon: Transaction price materially different from market value
indicators.desc: Price paid differs sharply from market value, comparable sales or estimates without commercial justification.
indicators.ctx: Sales at far off valuations or back-to-back trades.

indicators.name: Anonymous buyers through intermediaries, trusts or shell companies
indicators.canon: High-value asset held through opaque vehicle
indicators.desc: Property, art, vessels or other valuables are acquired or held via a company, trust or storage arrangement with concealed beneficial owners.

indicators.name: Storage in free ports without display or trade
indicators.canon: Art or collectibles held in free ports without display or trade
indicators.desc: Artworks are acquired and stored long term in free ports with no movement, display or documented purpose.
indicators.ctx: Artworks stored for long without movement.

indicators.name: Cash or crypto payment for high-value works
indicators.canon: High-value purchases paid in cash, crypto or non-standard funds
indicators.desc: High-value assets are bought with cash, crypto, third-party or otherwise non-standard funding.

indicators.name: Objects from conflict zones or countries with looting
indicators.canon: Objects from conflict zones or countries with looting
indicators.desc: Antiquities exported from affected regions with new papers.
indicators.ctx: Antiquities exported from affected regions with new papers.

indicators.name: Seller is dealer new to market or with sanctions or adverse media
indicators.canon: Seller is dealer new to market or with sanctions or adverse media

indicators.name: Use of art as collateral or for loan with unclear valuations
indicators.canon: Use of art as collateral or for loan with unclear valuations
indicators.desc: Loans secured on art with inflated valuations.
indicators.ctx: Loans secured on art with inflated valuations.
